description: Pins the MYY5 person-private AI profile codec: encode_person_profile_blob_raw(key, profile_id, account_number_hash, nonce, plaintext) over the AAD aad_person_profile_blob (role 'person-profile-blob', account_number_hash || profile_id, v0.2 prefix). The key is the person's phrase-derived profile KEK; the id and account hash are AAD-bound, so a blob moved to another person or vault fails to open. EXPECTED RUNTIME: instant. Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_person_profile_blob_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored`.

cases.description: Seal a fixed plaintext under a fixed key, profile id, account hash and nonce; the decoder must round-trip it. Changing any AAD input fails the open.
Opening the SAME sealed blob under a different account_number_hash must fail closed: the account hash is AAD-bound, so a profile moved to another vault does not decrypt.
